title: Security Deposit Withheld After Apartment Vacated
description: The tenant vacated the apartment after completing the lock-in period, but the landlord refused to return the security deposit citing repainting costs without sharing invoices or inspection records. The apartment was returned in normal wear-and-tear condition with no major damage.
timeline: Vacated apartment March 2024. Requested deposit refund. Landlord claimed renovation costs April 2024. No refund provided as of today.
evidence: Rental agreement signed by both parties
Photographs of apartment condition at vacating
Bank transfer receipt for deposit payment
desiredOutcome: Return of full security deposit amount (₹85,000) or court-ordered refund

title: Unsecured Personal Loan Not Repaid After 18 Months
description: Friend loaned ₹2,50,000 with verbal agreement for repayment in 12 equal monthly installments. Only 3 payments received. Borrower stopped responding to repayment requests after 6 months. Follow-up attempts made via WhatsApp and calls ignored.
timeline: Loan given March 2023. Monthly installments due. Last payment received August 2023. No response since.
evidence: WhatsApp chat with loan agreement details
UPI payment receipts of 3 installments received
desiredOutcome: Court-ordered repayment of outstanding amount (₹2,12,500) with interest

title: Inflated Electricity Bill From Faulty Meter Reading
description: Electricity bill doubled without any increase in usage. Previous average was ₹3,500 per month; received bill of ₹7,200 citing meter malfunction. Utility company acknowledged faulty meter in written response but delayed replacement for 60 days, billing customer at inflated rates.
timeline: Abnormal bill received June 2024. Complaint filed June 15. Meter replaced August 10. Still awaiting credit adjustment.
evidence: Utility company's written acknowledgment of faulty meter
Meter replacement invoice with date stamp
New meter readings showing normal consumption
Delay in meter replacement (60 days documented)
desiredOutcome: Refund of overcharged amount (₹8,500) with interest and adjustment for meter malfunction period

title: Website Development Not Completed as Contracted
description: Hired web development company to build e-commerce site with agreed scope. After 4 months and 70% payment (₹1,50,000), developer ceased work citing scope changes. Final deliverables missing (payment gateway, inventory system). Developer now unresponsive.
timeline: Contract signed March 2024. Progress updates until May 2024. Project abandoned June 2024. Final 30% payment withheld.
evidence: Signed software development contract with scope
Email chain with developer discussing timeline
Email stating project abandonment without clear reason
desiredOutcome: Refund of 70% advance payment (₹1,50,000) or completion of project at no additional cost

title: Online Purchase of Counterfeit Electronics
description: Purchased branded smartphone from e-commerce marketplace. Item appeared authentic with original packaging. After 1 week, phone malfunctioned and brand verification revealed it to be counterfeit. Seller profile now inactive. Refund request denied citing 'as sold' policy.
timeline: Purchase December 2023. Malfunction detected December 2024 (1 year later). Discovered counterfeit. Refund denied January 2024.
evidence: Original purchase receipt and order confirmation
Email correspondence with seller (denial of refund)
desiredOutcome: Full refund of ₹32,000 or replacement with genuine product, plus compensation for fraud

title: Fired Without Notice or Severance After 8 Years Service
description: Terminated employment after 8 years with company without notice, without final payment, and without severance. HR justified termination as 'performance issues' but provided no documentation or performance review warnings. Final 1.5 months salary (₹1,20,000) unpaid. No termination letter provided.
timeline: Employed since March 2016. Terminated abruptly May 2024. No prior warnings documented. Salary for April-May 2024 unpaid.
evidence: Salary slips for 7.5 months of employment
No termination letter with official reason
WhatsApp chat with HR manager about 'performance issues'
Colleagues' statement about no prior warnings (optional)
desiredOutcome: Unpaid salary (₹1,20,000) + statutory severance (8 years × monthly salary) + compensation for wrongful termination

title: Used Car Sold With Undisclosed Collision Damage
description: Purchased used car from private seller. Vehicle documentation stated 'mint condition' and 'accident-free'. One week after purchase, brake failure incident revealed collision damage to frame (previously welded). Damage reported to car insurance; inspection shows historical accident damage.
timeline: Car purchased March 2024. Brake failure May 2024. Insurance inspection revealed hidden collision damage.
evidence: Insurance inspection report showing collision damage
Repair invoice for brake system failure
WhatsApp chat with seller about condition (denial)
desiredOutcome: Full refund of purchase price (₹4,50,000) or repair cost reimbursement (₹1,80,000) + compensation

title: Water Damage to Flat From Neighbor's Faulty Plumbing
description: Water damage to apartment interior (walls, flooring, electrical fixtures) caused by neighbor's burst pipe. Neighbor's homeowner insurance has refused claim. Repair estimate: ₹2,50,000. Neighbor denies liability citing 'natural wear-and-tear'.
timeline: Pipe burst April 2024. Water damage to flat reported immediately. Repair estimate obtained. Neighbor's insurance claim denied.
evidence: Plumber's report confirming burst pipe origin
Insurance claim rejection letter from neighbor's insurer
Witness statement from building maintenance staff
Maintenance records showing pipe age and condition
desiredOutcome: Neighbor compensation for repair costs (₹2,50,000) via civil suit

title: Injury From Unattended Construction Site Hazard
description: Pedestrian injured on public road due to uncovered manhole left unattended by construction company. Medical bills: ₹85,000. Lost income during 2-month recovery: ₹40,000. Construction company's site manager admitted negligence verbally but company now denies responsibility.
timeline: Accident May 2024. Medical treatment May-June 2024. Recovery completed July 2024. No compensation offered.
evidence: FIR filed with police for negligence
Photographs of uncovered manhole at accident site
Site manager's WhatsApp acknowledgment of negligence
desiredOutcome: Compensation for medical bills (₹85,000), lost income (₹40,000), and pain & suffering (₹25,000) = ₹1,50,000

title: Workplace Harassment and Hostile Work Environment
description: Employee experienced repeated harassment from supervisor including derogatory comments about gender, exclusion from meetings, and verbal abuse in front of team. Formal complaint filed with HR 3 times in 6 months. HR took no action. Work environment became unbearable; employee forced to resign.
timeline: Harassment began January 2024. Complaints filed Feb, Mar, May 2024. No action taken. Resigned June 2024.
evidence: Formal written complaints to HR (3 instances)
Email chain with HR showing inaction
Audio recordings of abusive comments (if legal)
desiredOutcome: Compensation for harassment (₹3,00,000), lost salary for remaining contract period (₹2,40,000), and reinstatement or liquidated damages
